items.name: FBI
items.headline: AP source: FBI investigating apparent hack of its key national criminal justice database
items.description: The National Crime Information Center, known as the NCIC, is a computerized database of criminal justice information that is available to local, state and federal law enforcement agencies and includes records on fugitives, missing persons, criminal history data, stolen property and other topics.

sources.title: FBI investigates apparent hack of critical crime database
sources.description: The FBI is investigating an apparent breach of its National Crime Information Center, two people briefed on the matter told NBC News. The FBI’s National Crime Information Center is used to connect federal, state and local authorities so that important law enforcement information is available nationwide. NBC News’ Julie Tsirkin reports.

sources.description: President Donald Trump confirmed on Saturday that the FBI’s National Crime Information Center database was targeted in a hack.

sources.description: Starting early each morning, logging trucks thunder past Amber and Andrew Ngundue ‘s tidy country home in southeast Pulaski County. The procession continues until after dark, hauling away timber from the vast woods behind their house, a rural bottomland forest resplendent with streams and wildlife — and once listed among the most ecologically significant spots in central Arkansas.

sources.title: ICE officers arrest at least 1 passenger boarding Alaska Airlines flight in Seattle
sources.description: Masked immigration officers detained at least one person on a crowded airport jet bridge in Seattle as people were boarding Saturday, causing what Alaska Airlines called a "distressing" scene for passengers and employees and delaying the Los Angeles-bound flight.Videos of the incident showed officers dragging away at least one person at Seattle-Tacoma International Airport as a woman screamed that her daughter is being taken and she has a work permit.
